history.title: Dyno Logs
history.empty: No six-axis snapshots yet. Open the Dyno tab, run an assessment, and save your first snapshot.
history.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this snapshot? This action cannot be undone.

IGN-01.name: First Ignition
IGN-01.desc: Complete a dyno action on any day (assess, save, or calculate 1RM / plates). Opening the app does not count.

ARC-01.name: First Archive
ARC-01.desc: Save your first six-axis result on the Dyno tab.

RHY-03.name: Weekly Rhythm
RHY-03.desc: Have 3 days with a dyno action this week (Monday–Sunday).

RUN-07.name: Seven-Day Break-in
RUN-07.desc: Reach 7 days with a dyno action.

RUN-30.name: Break-in Complete
RUN-30.desc: Reach 30 days with a dyno action.

CRS-04.name: Cruise Lock
CRS-04.desc: Hit 3 dyno days a week, 4 weeks in a row.

HIST-10.name: Data Foundation
HIST-10.desc: Save 10 six-axis results in your local log.

PR-01.name: First Break
PR-01.desc: Beat your previous best on any axis. Filling all six scores is not enough — it has to be a new high.

SPEC-6.name: Six-Axis Live
SPEC-6.desc: Strength, power, cardio, muscle, body fat, and grip all have a score above 0 (arm size not included).

ARM-01.name: Girth Logged
ARM-01.desc: Complete the arm-size test and save a score. Optional — not part of the six-axis radar.

5K-01.name: 5K Finish
5K-01.desc: Save a 5 km time on the cardio page. Optional — not part of the six-axis radar.

SPR-01.name: 100 m Start
SPR-01.desc: Save a 100 m time on the explosive page. Optional — not part of the six-axis radar.

SOM-01.name: Somatotype Map
SOM-01.desc: Complete a Heath-Carter somatotype analysis. Optional — not part of the six-axis radar.
